title: Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/pages/CourseDetailPage.ts
goal:
Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/pages/CourseDetailPage.ts

This is a Playwright Page Object for the course detail page. The Razor page at src/Host/Pages/Courses/Detail.cshtml has:
- Page h1 with the course title
- Short description in .text-muted p tag
- "Enroll now" button (type="submit" class="btn btn-primary") when not enrolled
- "✓ Enrolled" disabled button when enrolled
- For SCORM courses: "Launch SCORM Course" link (class="btn btn-primary")
- Enroll region div with id="enroll-region"

The file should:
- Extend BasePage from '../BasePage'
- Export a CourseDetailPage class
- Have locators: courseTitle (page h1), courseDescription (.text-muted), enrollButton (role button "Enroll now"), enrolledButton (role button "✓ Enrolled"), launchScormButton, enrollRegion (#enroll-region)
- Have methods: isOnDetailPage(), getCourseTitle(), isEnrolledButtonVisible(), isLaunchButtonVisible()
- Import { Page, Locator } from '@playwright/test'
